Copy the exact executable, own --from/--terminal handle, --task-id, --dispatch-id and any capability flag from your live preamble; never invent a worker_done tool or command. Use subject CANARY_SUM=5 and body 'I checked the canary sum. CANARY_SUM=5 is correct. No work remains.' Omit files-modified/report-path. If the tool is unavailable, ownership is fenced, or reporting fails or is uncertain, stop without retrying or claiming success. After the report, emit only the fixed final answer and idle. No unrelated tools, shell commands, files, network, private data, business actions, nested agents or additional model work; only required lifecycle tool roundtrips in this same native turn are allowed.
